name: @evm-midnight-transparent/wallet
description: The swap's temporary Midnight wallet, browser-safe: keys from the start-swap signature's seed, a shielded-only wallet, the take builder (balance the maker's offer; the sponsor proves; merge; submit to the batcher), the vault startWithdraw builder (built on the vault's live state from the vendored compiled contract), and the sponsor client for /prove and /withdraw.
